title: Check tool access before calling it impossible
rule: When a link or tool will not open, list the connected tools before saying access is impossible.
consequence: A flat claim that nothing could open the link was wrong and cost the user two rounds.

evidence.quote: Your assertion is not correct, sessions open these links all the time.

title: Run the migration check before seeding
rule: When a seed task fails on a missing column in the app repo, run the pending migration check first.
consequence: Seeding against a stale schema wasted a debugging round.

title: Ask before touching vendored code
rule: When a fix lands in vendor/, ask before editing it.
consequence: A vendored patch was overwritten on the next update.

title: Trust the flaky test label
rule: When a test is labelled flaky, skip it.

title: Lead with the answer
rule: When reporting back, put the answer in the first sentence and the detail after.

evidence.quote: just tell me the result first
